mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing lansoprazole metabolism via CYP3A4, while lansoprazole may increase clarithromycin levels; both drugs also inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased systemic exposure of each other.
action: Monitor for increased lansoprazole and clarithromycin adverse effects; dose adjustment may be considered; this combination is commonly used in H. pylori eradication regimens but requires clinical vigilance.
